probe.text_sample: Enerblock Panel | Enerblock Menu Menu Contact Contact Approach Solutions Enerblock Panel Enerblock Robot Enerblock Frame Enerblock System® Company Projects Contact Digitalization Sustainability Certification FAQs LinkedIn ES | EN Solutions Enerblock Panel Industrialized innovation in building envelope enclosure Industrialized 2D panels that transform the enclosure of façades, slabs and roofs into a faster, more controlled and predictable process, aligned with the technical and regulatory requirements of contemporary construction. Intro It is an industrialized element designed to resolve the enclosure of the building envelope through a precise, lightweight and highly controlled system. Its manufacturing integrates robotics, automation and digital vision, ensuring a constant and traceable level of quality from design to installation. Thanks to its multilayer design, Enerblock Panel meets the most demanding requirements in thermal and acoustic insulation, fire resistance and health performance, making it possible to replace complex construction processes with a reliable, repeatable and project-specific industrialized solution.
